summary: Backend-only testing for iteration 32 (gallery field + _BRAND_PAGES=5 for Vivo X100). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration32_gallery_and_vivo.py (14 tests). All 14 passed on final run. Verified: (a) new `gallery` list of >=5 fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot HTTPS URLs on iPhone 15 payload, (b) `gallery` capped at <=12 items, (c) `hero_image` still populated, (d) specs_filled >=40 for iPhone 15 (real value ~50+), (e) Vivo X100 (previously 404) now returns 200 with matched_name containing 'X100' — confirms _BRAND_PAGES=5 change works, (f) unmatchable query ZZZTest99/apple still returns 404, (g) no regression on iPhone 15 / Galaxy S24 Ultra / OnePlus 12R / Pixel 8 (all 200 with gallery+specs), (h) cache path <1500ms on second call, (i) vendor product create + PATCH /api/vendor/me/products/{id} still persists serial_number/imei_1/imei_2. One flaky 502 (Cloudflare Bad Gateway on preview ingress) hit Pixel 8 on the first run and cleared on retry — not a code issue.

minor.issue: Occasional 502 Bad Gateway observed once for Pixel 8 during initial cold-cache fetch (~9s server time — see backend.out.log). Cleared on retry. Likely Cloudflare ingress timeout while GSMArena took ~9s. Consider raising uvicorn/worker timeout or adding a retry-once wrapper around the outbound GSMArena fetch.

action_items: No code changes required — all iteration-32 acceptance criteria pass.
Optional hardening: wrap the outbound GSMArena GET in _fetch_specs_for_url with a single retry on network/timeout errors to mitigate the rare ingress 502 we saw on Pixel 8 during cold-cache fetch.
critical_code_review_comments: products_master_specs.py:_fetch_gallery_images correctly handles the underscore-vs-dash slug quirk (GSMArena serves 301 on the dash URL then 200 on the underscore variant — logs show this pattern). Good defensive coding with follow_redirects=True.
gallery cap of 12 is enforced in _fetch_gallery_images (line 435) — verified by test_gallery_capped_at_12.
products_master_cache stores the full payload including `gallery`, so cache hits also return the new field — verified by TestCacheFast.test_second_call_is_fast.

rca_of_issue: One transient failure during the initial run: Pixel 8 GSMArena fetch took ~9s and the preview ingress returned 502 Bad Gateway to the client while the backend was still waiting. Retry succeeded immediately (2.32s). This is an infrastructure-timing artifact of the emergent preview URL, not a code defect. The endpoint itself completed successfully (backend logs show `GET .../Pixel+8 HTTP/1.1 200 OK` on the retry). Recommend a single httpx retry in _fetch_specs_for_url as low-priority hardening.
